# GetDebugTypeCanBeUsed

<Badge type="info" text="info" /> <Badge type="tip" text="on by default" /> <Badge type="info" text="PHP ≥ 8.0" />

Group: [Language level migration](/rules/#language-level-migration) · PhpStorm name: `GetDebugTypeCanBeUsedInspection`

The hand-rolled idiom "class name for objects, `gettype()` otherwise",
written as a ternary over `is_object()`, is what PHP 8.0's
`get_debug_type()` provides in one call. Suggest the built-in.

## Example

Language level 8.1:

```php{6,7}
<?php
namespace Shop;

function label(object|string $payload, array $rows): array {
    return [
        is_object($rows[0]) ? get_class($rows[0]) : gettype($rows[0]),
        'kind: ' . (\is_object($payload) ? \get_class($payload) : gettype($payload)),
        is_object($payload) ? get_class($payload) : gettype($rows),
        is_object($payload) ? gettype($payload) : get_class($payload),
        is_object($payload) ? get_class($payload) : 'scalar',
        is_object($payload) ?: gettype($payload),
        (is_object($payload)) ? get_class($payload) : gettype($payload),
    ];
}
```

Reported:

<ul>
<li>line 6: Use &#39;get_debug_type($rows[0])&#39; instead (scalar type names differ from gettype()).</li>
<li>line 7: Use &#39;\get_debug_type($payload)&#39; instead (scalar type names differ from gettype()).</li>
</ul>

## Configure

In [`custos.json`](/guide/configuration):

```json
{
  "rules": {
    "GetDebugTypeCanBeUsed": {
      "enabled": false
    }
  }
}
```

## Suppress

Before the statement or declaration (or the first statement of the file), either of:

```php
// @custos-ignore GetDebugTypeCanBeUsed

/**
 * @noinspection GetDebugTypeCanBeUsedInspection
 */
```
